Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: reference1, approved paper-pallet state atlas from The Picture Shop.
Supporting reference2: current menu screenshot marked by the user, showing the V-shaped gaps that must be corrected.
Create a replacement FOUR-STATE LEFT/RIGHT PALLET PAIR SPRITE ATLAS, TWO COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 1536x1024, true transparent alpha. Match the approved warm honey wood, three timber blocks with two fork pockets, nails, cream layered paper, crisp black pixel outlines and subtle shading. Paper faces entirely blank for dynamic text.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY CHANGE: these are complementary LEFT and RIGHT pallets intended to meet almost flush at their inner ends. LEFT COLUMN sprite has angled perspective ONLY on its FAR LEFT exterior edge; its RIGHT INNER edge is a perfectly straight vertical square-cut edge from the back/top paper edge all the way down to the front wooden foot. RIGHT COLUMN sprite has angled perspective ONLY on its FAR RIGHT exterior edge; its LEFT INNER edge is perfectly vertical and square cut all the way down. NO trapezoid perspective bevel at either inner edge. Paper sheets reach these square-cut inner edges, wood deck and inner end block also align vertically, no taper, no diagonal notch, no V-shaped wedge. The pair would form one nearly continuous horizontal surface with a fine straight vertical seam when placed adjacent. They still read as TWO distinct pallets, each with their own center block and fork pockets.
Rows top to bottom: NORMAL clean cream paper and honey wood; HOVER slightly brighter paper and warm deck highlights; SELECTED amber-gold paper perimeter and deck lip, black-print-friendly cream center; PRESSED slightly compressed stack with amber edge, thinner paper layers and deeper front shadows. Keep alignment and identical mounting footprint.
For easy runtime extraction: LEFT pallet occupies x60..734, RIGHT pallet x802..1476. Every row occupies y30..234, y286..490, y542..746, y798..1002 respectively. Outer slopes are only at x60 side and x1476 side. Inner straight edges at x734 and x802. Preserve about95px tall blank top paper face, layered front edge below, wood deck and fork pockets below that. Wide low silhouettes, elevated FRONT view, not diamond-isometric.
No lettering, numbers, state captions, icons or extra straps/clamps. Only 8 production sprite frames, no full menu, no scene, no shelf. Everything outside the eight silhouettes alpha transparent; no background, checkerboard, floor shadow or colored matte.
